purpose: Test whether adding locked video-fact information at the native Q-Former output interface can causally rescue commentary generation.
scope: development causal-rescue pilot; not a final causal bottleneck ranking and not a holdout evaluation

locked_packet.label_source: Codex video-only development labels; not independent human gold

interface.downstream: the historical llama_proj (768 to 4096), Llama checkpoint, restricted-token processor, BOS/EOS/PAD contract, and decoder are unchanged

steering.estimator: fold-local positive-minus-negative class centroids in the full 32x768 Q-Former output space
steering.leakage_guard: directions, centroids, scale statistics, and caps for a test clip use training matches only; the held-out video-only fact label supplies only the oracle sign
steering.total_residual_cap: 0.5 times the fold-local median Frobenius distance from the training-fold Q-Former centroid
steering.task_combination: mean of all eligible stable-task signed directions before dose and clipping
steering.no_eligible_task_policy: leave all four conditions identical and exclude the clip from intervention-effect denominators

generation.reason_for_not_matching_stage1_sampled_t: paired deterministic decoding removes sampling noise; every condition in this pilot uses the same decoder contract

primary_review.unit: paired clip-level video-fact consistency review using the locked video-only labels, without reference commentary
primary_review.positive_rescue_rule: at least 5 of 48 absolute additional central-fact-correct clips, improved:regressed at least 2:1, and the norm-matched control does not achieve the same gain
primary_review.interpretation: a positive result supports Q-Former-output information loss as a causal contributor; it does not prove Q-Former is the only bottleneck

rankability.reason: oracle labels and a centroid residual are an upper-bound rescue, not a supervision- and capacity-matched replacement module; final ranking needs comparable interventions and match-disjoint replication

safety.output_policy: new isolated output paths and refuse overwrite
